questions.question: Dr. Taki is elected to the Regional Council. Dr. Touitou reminds him of his new responsibilities. According to Article 48 of Law 07-05, what is one of the attributions of the Regional Council?
options: Set the tariffs for dental procedures
Hear registration requests with the Order
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 48 lists the attributions of the Regional Council, including hearing registration requests with the Order.' Dr. Taki: 'I will seriously study each file.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou sits on the National Council. Dr. Taki asks her how the setting of dues works. According to Article 30, who sets the amount of dues?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 30 provides that the National Council sets the amount of members' dues as well as their collection methods.' Dr. Taki: 'I better understand the role of the National Council.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has received a disciplinary complaint. Dr. Touitou advises him to check the procedure. According to Article 71, what right does the accused dentist have?
options: He can be assisted by a colleague or a lawyer
He must appear in person without assistance
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 71 provides that the dentist can be assisted, at all stages, by a colleague or a lawyer.' Dr. Taki: 'I will be assisted by a colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou is a candidate for the presidency of the National Council. Dr. Taki wonders about the conditions. According to Article 19, how is the National Council composed?
options: Of 13 elected members including the president
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 19 provides that the National Council is composed of 13 elected members, including the president.' Dr. Taki: 'I will follow your campaign closely.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has changed his region of practice. Dr. Touitou reminds him of the procedure. According to Article 10, how is the change of professional domicile carried out?
options: By a simple declaration to the National Council
By a request to the competent Regional Council
By a decision of the Minister
By a publication in a newspaper
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 10 provides that the change is carried out upon a request filed with the president of the competent Regional Council.' Dr. Taki: 'I will file my request quickly.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou has been struck off from the register. Dr. Taki is concerned. According to Article 57, what does definitive striking off entail?
options: A reprimand with entry in the file
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 57 provides that definitive striking off entails the definitive prohibition from practicing dental medicine.' Dr. Taki: 'I will do everything to avoid this sanction.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki wishes to run for the Regional Council elections. Dr. Touitou informs him of the rules. According to Article 20, who can vote in the elections?
options: Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues
Dentists with more than 10 years of experience
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 20 provides that voters are Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues at the date of the elections.' Dr. Taki: 'I must be up to date with my dues.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou examines an appeal against a disciplinary decision. According to Article 58, disciplinary action is exercised on appeal before:
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 58 provides that the appeal is exercised before the National Council.' Dr. Taki: 'I will prepare my appeal file.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has submitted his registration request but has not received a response. According to Article 7, within what timeframe must the president of the Regional Council make a decision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 7 provides that registration is pronounced within 30 days.' Dr. Taki: 'I will follow up with the Regional Council.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou explains to Dr. Taki the role of the legal advisor. According to Article 36, what can the legal advisor do if the National Council exceeds its powers?
options: Refer the matter to the Minister
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 36 provides that the legal advisor requests the president to submit the decision to a second deliberation.' Dr. Taki: 'I will follow this procedure.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been elected to the Regional Council. According to Article 42, how many consecutive terms can he serve?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 42 specifies that they can only be re-elected for a single consecutive term.' Dr. Taki: 'I will give my best during my term.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou finds that a colleague is practicing without being registered. According to Article 13, what is the Order's mission in this situation?
options: Fight against illegal practice of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 13 provides that the Order proposes and encourages any action aimed at combating illegal practice.' Dr. Taki: 'I will report this case to the Regional Council.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has received a summons from the Regional Council. Dr. Touitou reminds him of his rights. According to Article 71, can he be assisted by a lawyer?
options: Yes, he can be assisted by a colleague or a lawyer
Yes, but only by a colleague
No, he must defend himself alone
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 71 provides that the dentist can be assisted by a colleague or a lawyer.' Dr. Taki: 'I will take a specialized lawyer.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou wishes to submit her candidacy to the National Council. According to Article 21, what condition must she fulfill?
options: Have practiced the profession for at least 8 years
Have been president of a Regional Council
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 21 provides that dentists who have practiced the profession for at least 8 years are eligible.' Dr. Taki: 'You have the required experience.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki wonders about the composition of the Regional Council. According to Article 39, how many members compose a Regional Council for a region of 400 to 800 dentists?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 39 provides that the number of members is 6 for a region of 400 to 800 dentists.' Dr. Taki: 'I will check the number of dentists in my region.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou has been suspended for one month. Dr. Taki is concerned about the consequences. According to Article 56, the suspension may be suspended. Under what conditions does it become enforceable?
options: If the dentist is sanctioned again within 4 years
If the dentist does not pay their dues
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 56 provides that the sanction becomes enforceable if, within a period of four years, the dentist is subject to another disciplinary sanction.' Dr. Taki: 'I will be very careful.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been refused registration. According to Article 8, what is his recourse and within what timeframe?
options: Appeal before the National Council within 30 days
Appeal before the Administrative Court within 60 days
Referral to the Minister within 90 days
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 8 provides for an appeal before the National Council within thirty days.' Dr. Taki: 'I will appeal immediately.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou chairs a session of the Regional Council. According to Article 52, what is the quorum condition for valid deliberation?
options: The presence of more than half of the members
The presence of a third of the members
The presence of the President only
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 52 provides that the Council can only deliberate validly if more than half of its members are present.' Dr. Taki: 'I will ensure the quorum.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki discovers that a foreign colleague wishes to register. According to Article 5, what condition must a foreign dentist fulfill?
options: Be a national of a country with a reciprocity agreement with Morocco
Have practiced 10 years in his country
Be married to a Moroccan woman
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 5 requires that the foreigner be a national of a State that has concluded a reciprocity agreement with Morocco.' Dr. Taki: 'I will check the agreement with his country.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must pronounce a disciplinary decision. According to Article 55, what are the possible sanctions?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 55 lists warning, reprimand, suspension, and striking off.' Dr. Taki: 'I will apply the proportionate sanction.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki is elected to the Regional Council. According to Article 48, what are the attributions of the Regional Council?
options: Set the tariffs for dental procedures
Hear registration requests and disciplinary matters
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 48 lists the attributions of the Regional Council, including registration with the order and disciplinary matters.' Dr. Taki: 'I will study my new responsibilities.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must vote in the National Council elections. According to Article 20, under what condition can she vote?
options: Be up to date with her dues
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 20 provides that voters are Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues.' Dr. Taki: 'I will check my situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has resigned from the Regional Council. Dr. Touitou reminds him of the rules. According to Article 45, what happens in the event of a vacancy?
options: The substitute is called to sit
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 45 provides that the substitute is called to sit in the event of a vacancy.' Dr. Taki: 'I will notify my substitute.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou explains to Dr. Taki the importance of continuing education. According to Article 13, with whom does the Order organize continuing education actions?
options: With higher education institutions and scientific associations
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 13 provides for coordination with higher education institutions and scientific associations.' Dr. Taki: 'I will participate in the organized trainings.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki, after having sat on the Regional Council for 4 years, receives congratulations from Dr. Touitou. What is the next step for Dr. Taki?
options: Become an expert in ordinal law and commit at the national level
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Commitment at the national level is the next step for a dentist passionate about ordinal matters.' Dr. Taki: 'I will run for the National Council.'
